parameters.query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claims) AS total_claims, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM denials) AS total_denials, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appeals) AS total_appeals, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_recovered), 0) FROM appeals WHERE status = 'Approved') AS recovered_revenue, (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(id) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE ROUND((COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'Approved' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(id)), 1) END FROM appeals WHERE status IN ('Approved', 'Rejected')) AS approval_rate;
